A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual served as an '''Imperial garrison historian''' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial garrison historian was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who maintained important records.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, he resided in the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was there that he met Imperial spacers, sent to help him by an [[Pex (Imperial PR officer)|Imperial PR officer]]. The historian had an important mission for the spacers, which involved acquiring a historical disk which he needed for a report he was writing. The Imperials had the choice to either slay a number of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] foes for the disk, or meet up with a noble in the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] [[Bestine tavern|tavern]]. Finally, they successfully acquire the disk.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

It was then that the Imperial spacers had to continue his mission, by meeting up with a commoner in [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]]. The commoner instructed the Imperials to meet up with another individual in [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]. Upon doing so, Imperial promptly returned to the historian, to inform him that he had completed his mission. Yet the mission was not truly complete, for the historian had the Imperial visit an [[Unidentified Imperial data officer|Imperial data officer]] at the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] [[Science Outpost]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCorporalTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of the Imperial garrison historian]]
An Imperial garrison historian, who lacks an official name, appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial garrison historian was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref> he could be found in Narmle and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]," which sent players on an important mission throughout the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:HED" /> After the live event ended, the Imperial garrison historian never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
